item.title: ISO/IEC 42001 Guide
item.description:
This guide explains, from the perspective of open source practitioners, the key requirements of ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System) that intersect with open source management. It provides practical guidance on what must be complied with when using open source frameworks, pre-trained models, and training datasets in AI systems, and on how to structure an AI SBOM.

Author : OpenChain Korea Work Group / CC BY 4.0

What is ISO/IEC 42001?

ISO/IEC 42001:2023 is an international standard for an AI management system (AIMS, AI Management System) that enables organizations to develop, operate, and manage AI systems responsibly and transparently.
